status: prospectively specified follow-up; not biological validation
inputs: new seed 91821, independent train 64/validation 16/test 32 histories, 120 samples each, random step holds from 3 to 9 samples; amplitude Gaussian 0.35
task: predict clean current minus clean 0.5s-ago input from noisy observations; discard first 10 frames; no closed loop
graphs: real and five previous degree-preserving chemical rewires; same gap network, three previously used random sign seeds
method: Heun 0.025s with samples every 0.1s, fixed input nodes AFDL/R, output RIAL/R or all 302; underlying source weights and assumptions same as pilot
budgets: first 4, 16, 64 training sequences; validation always independent 16; ridge penalty per-sample MSE from 1e-8,1e-6,1e-4,1e-2; all conditions kept
tests: clean observation and additive per-sample Gaussian input noise SD 0.05 and 0.15 with fixed paired noise; trained on clean only; score versus zero prediction; training labels clean; test sequences independent
controls: linear predictor of current observation trained and selected by same rules; all-node readout has direct access to sensory input
caveats: synthetic single task, assumed weights and signs, gap fixed, readouts differ in dimension; repeated graph and parameter seeds not biological replications, no claim real neural superiority
